name: Gemini 3.5 Pro

lifecycle.note: Named by Google as a forthcoming model; not released as of 2026-10-01. On 2026-07-21 Google said it was testing with partners and would be made broadly available when ready.

announced.note: Named in the Gemini 3.5 announcement as already in internal use, with rollout planned for the following month; no release date was given.

summary.text: Gemini 3.5 Pro is an announced language model in Google's Gemini Pro line, named on 19 May 2026 as already in internal use, with a rollout planned for the following month. In July 2026 Google said it was testing the model with partners; it had not been released by 1 October 2026.

notes: Announced stub. The Gemini API models overview and release notes list no Gemini 3.5 Pro model or id on 2026-10-01, and the rollout planned for June 2026 did not happen by then. Add a release date, API id and capabilities once Google releases it.
